limitations: Native text extraction is heuristic and requires review; structured employment chronology and complete automatic field population remain partial.
Scanned PDF OCR is not implemented; image-only PDFs show NEEDS_OCR.
LinkedIn is an explicit saved URL only; remote profile import is not implemented.
Name and email are required before saving the initial profile and uploading a resume.
Job preferences are persisted but are not yet automatic search filters.
Broader document types, tailoring and the full original requirements remain incomplete.
privacy: No private feedback artifacts or personal source values are included. All test content is synthetic.
environment_notes: Port 18702 was occupied; isolated acceptance moved to 18703 without stopping its owner. Existing mjobs stack was not rebuilt.
verification_scope: Compose acceptance preceded the final New profile selection guard; final Chromium acceptance exercises that guard on the final compiled local UI.
